items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: it didn’t say to Dick or to Betty, it said “Get Well Quick.”

ctx.x: Oh, well we’ll just have to do Interview Part II then where we’ll feature a reading.

Yeah. But any subject. Even bad health. My wife and I underwent serious illnesses at the very end of last year and the beginning of this one. She had two congestive heart failure attacks, hospitalized, quadruple bypass. The same day that she had quadruple bypass I was diagnosed with prostate cancer. So it was not a happy day. And the men in the Alumni All-Stars sent us flowers and a get well card. And the get well card, being cheap, it didn’t say to Dick or to Betty, it said “Get Well Quick.” So I sent them a…
Well it will come to you.
